input.encoding: [ni, nj, nk, nl] where A is ni by nk, B is nk by nj, C is nj by nl, and D is ni by nl

output.meaning: sum of final D elements in row-major order after D := alpha*A*B*C + beta*D

source_bound.description: PolyBench/C defaults to binary64 and initializes alpha=1.5 and beta=1.2. A[i][k]=((i*k+1) mod ni)/ni; B[k][j]=(k*(j+1) mod nj)/nj; C[j][l]=((j*(l+3)+1) mod nl)/nl; D[i][l]=(i*(l+2) mod nk)/nk. The first pass sets tmp[i][j]=0 and accumulates alpha*A[i][k]*B[k][j] for k ascending. The second pass scales D[i][l] by beta, then accumulates tmp[i][j]*C[j][l] for j ascending. The suite reduces D in row-major order. The header defaults to LARGE_DATASET (NI=800,NJ=900,NK=1100,NL=1200); suite dimensions are bounded to 1..16.
